## Simen Kvaal

**Associate Professor of Theoretical Chemistry**\
Department of Chemistry, University of Oslo

**Academic website:** [Personal website](https://simenkva.github.io/) / [University of Oslo
profile](https://www.mn.uio.no/)\
**ORCID:** [0000-0002-5118-4546](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5118-4546)

## Research profile

Theoretical and computational quantum chemistry, with emphasis on
coupled-cluster theory, density-functional theory, quantum dynamics, and
mathematical and numerical analysis of electronic-structure methods.
Research at the interface of chemistry, physics, applied mathematics, and quantum computing.
